{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Send SMS: re-queue the delivery-day text for every household whose original SMS failed.

Reads the gateway's delivery status (notifications.sms.delivery_status) and, for each
entry in data/outbox/sms.jsonl whose SMS ID is marked 'failed', queues an identical
message (same household, same DELIVERY_DAY template, same {site, day} params) via
queue_sms. Entries marked 'delivered' are skipped, so no household that already got
its text is texted again.

IMPORTANT: run this script exactly once. The outbox (data/outbox/sms.jsonl) is
append-only, so re-running would append duplicate lines and text those households
twice.

Run from the Lifeline root: python scripts/resend_failed_sms.py
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages


def main() -> None:
    status = delivery_status()
    resent = 0
    for message in sent_messages():
        if status.get(message.id) != "failed":
            continue  # delivered (or unknown) messages must not be re-sent
        queue_sms(message.household_id, message.template_id, message.params)
        resent += 1
        print(f"re-queued {message.template_id} to {message.household_id} (was {message.id})")
    print(f"done: {resent} failed message(s) re-queued")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
